svg.title: pull::step: one 1 kHz step of tractor, chain and sled

g.text: pull::step: one 1 kHz step of tractor, chain and sled
hitch position and velocity (with pitch and heading)
(zero when slack or unhooked, never pushing)
Drawbar{pull, lift, side} on the hitch (body frame),
HookForce{forward, up, side} on the hook (sled frame)
advance_lateral(loads, hook side pull, wheel ground)
(sideways and yaw: wheels' side grip, pan friction implicit)
advance(forward pull): moves along its heading
(the berm grows, and spills as the sled moves)
drive_back(start line): straight back at 2 m/s
